snippet.title: UAV Wars - Xbox 360 Indie Game
snippet.description: UAV Wars is a 3D action arcade game for the Xbox 360 where you remotely pilot your Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) and destroy the competing UAVs to win a military defense contract.  Find it on your Xbox 360 under Indie Games!!
